examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A single-line field. It needs a visible label or an `aria-label`; the placeholder is only a hint.

examples.title: Label and helper text
examples.description: Input is the bare control. Pair it with a `<label htmlFor>` and link helper copy through `aria-describedby`.

examples.title: Input types
examples.description: `type` passes straight to the native input, so the right keyboard and autofill come with it.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Pass `value` and `onChange` to own the text. Every native input attribute is forwarded.

examples.title: Error
examples.description: `state="error"` turns the border red and keeps it red on hover and focus. Set `aria-invalid` and describe the problem in a message.

examples.title: aria-invalid on its own
examples.description: `aria-invalid="true"` shows the same red border without `state`, so a field validated by a form library looks right.

examples.title: Disabled and read-only
examples.description: A disabled field dims on a grey surface and leaves the tab order. A read-only field keeps its look, can be focused and its text can be copied.

examples.title: Check icon
examples.description: `showCheckIcon` scales a check in while the field is focused and eases it out on blur.

examples.title: Numbers
examples.description: `type="number"` refuses `e` by default and hides the native spinners. `allowDecimal`, `hideNumberSpinners` and `preventNumberExponent` change each rule.

examples.title: Consecutive spaces
examples.description: Text fields ignore a second space in a row and leave the caret where it is. Set `preventConsecutiveSpaces={false}` to keep every space.

examples.title: With a button
examples.description: The field fills the space its flex row gives it. Enter inside it submits the form, like any native input.

examples.title: In a form
examples.description: `name` and the native constraint attributes work as usual, so a plain form post or `FormData` reads the values.

examples.title: Width
examples.description: Input is `w-full`: 44px high and as wide as its container.

examples.title: Complete field
examples.description: Need a label, helper text that animates in, an error, a counter or a clear button in one component? Use TextField, which shares the same field styling.
